Schematic of the M481 oscillator/cue amplifier module: 1458 op-amp oscillator with frequency and distortion trims feeding osc out and osc-to-meter outputs, M1/M2 re-entry switching, PFL/solo inputs, and an LM377 cue amplifier (2W, 8 ohm) with mute relay.
